who.value: casual seller starting a new listing

job.value: start a new listing or pick up a draft

arrivedFrom.value: the Sell tab in the bottom bar

questions.title: The screen's job is clear from the first screen
questions.why: 'List anything yourself' with 'Drafts', 'Create a listing' and 'Scan cards' makes the screen's purpose clear.

questions.title: The action that does the job stands out most
questions.why: 'Create a listing' and 'Scan cards' are two equal-weight outlined cards, so neither reads as the main way in.

questions.title: Every label says what happens when tapped
questions.why: 'Create a listing' and 'Manage' predict, but 'Scan cards' doesn't say trading cards — only the illustration does.

questions.title: No terms this user wouldn't know
questions.why: 'Sell to Carousell' is explained by 'Sell directly to us'; other labels are plain.

questions.title: Only asks what this user can decide at this stage
questions.why: The seller only chooses how to start.

questions.title: Advanced detail is tucked away
questions.why: Drafts scroll sideways and their management sits behind 'Manage'.

questions.title: Everything fits this stage and this user
questions.why: The 'Sell to Carousell' tiles (Mobile, Luxury, Fashion, Cars) are a different path from 'List anything yourself' and take the lower half of the screen.

questions.title: Little reading needed to act
questions.why: Labels and short tile subtitles only.
